title: Fluffy's Programmer Art Consistency Pack
description: Fixes some inconsistencies in programmer art intended to be used with packs like PACP this just updates some textures that were never updated to match textures that were updated
body: ![Preview of Affected Blocks](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6074a3fc2e2d65be33f5e8cc62d61c2638e9af53.png)This is a resource pack intended to be applied on top of programmer art and ontop of Programmer art Continuation Project i will probably make a version without the updated netherrack that uses the beta 1.7 cobblestone instead of the alpha cobblestone for those who prefer the PACP nylium i couldnt use the texture from that pack for legal reasons so i made my own using myclium its not much of a noticable difference anyway
